sentences.t: MageCart is listed in the catalogue record under the name MageCart, with no aliases and no tools recorded.
WIRED describes Magecart as a group of hackers that steals credit card numbers.
According to WIRED, Magecart has been behind some of the bigger hacks of recent years, from British Airways to Ticketmaster.
WIRED says Magecart hackers are casting the widest possible net to find vulnerable ecommerce sites.
The group's method is card skimming, as WIRED's headline puts it. Its stated goal is stealing credit card numbers.
WIRED reports that the group has hit 17,000 domains in the past few months alone, and puts this down to poor security hygiene.
The WIRED article was published on 11 July 2019. It names British Airways and Ticketmaster among past hacks.
The author warns that the method could lead to even bigger problems. This is a forward-looking warning, not a confirmed outcome.
Online shops should keep their sites patched and well secured, since the group is reported to look for vulnerable ones.
